# puffin_egui compatibility copy

This directory vendors the Rust sources from `puffin_egui` 0.30.0 and updates
them for egui 0.34. The upstream crate is maintained by Embark Studios at
<https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/puffin> and is licensed under MIT OR
Apache-2.0.

The compatibility change is intentionally small so this copy can be removed
once upstream publishes support for the workspace's egui version.
